entities.name: Arnold's Van
entities.description:
is a service van with Fazbear Entertainment branding on it. It's owned by Arnold, and was used during the beginning and some endings of Five Nights at Freddy's: Secret of the Mimic.

Arnold's van is a faded blue work van with a white stripe and a Fazbear Entertainment logo on the back corner. It has two seats with an open back filled with work supplies, shelves, and makeshift work tables. There is a heater hung behind-above the driver's seat that is connected to a propane tank, suggesting the van doesn't have heating. The passenger's seat and floorboard is filled with trash, both from food and numerous cans of soda. There is also a Spring Bonnie bobble head on the dashboard.

At the beginning of Secret of the Mimic, Arnold is seen driving on a open stretch of road when he gets a call from Dispatch who informs him that he has a job at Murray's Costume Manor. After entering the parking lot, Arnold takes out a Data Diver and enters the building.

In the Walk Away Ending, Arnold is allowed to go into the back garage where his van has been moved. He begins to drive off when Dispatch gets in contact and after telling Arnold, promptly fires him. A red light illuminates the back and Arnold looks into the rearview mirror to see that the Mimic has been hiding in the back. Mimic rushes towards him and attacks.

entities.name: Forest Animatronics
entities.description:
The forest animatronics are a series of animatronics based around forests, who appear in Five Nights at Freddy's AR: Special Delivery as limited time animatronic skins. They were introduced for the Haunted Forest Event that started on November 12, 2020.

Woodland Toy Freddy is a version of Toy Freddy, and the first forest animatronic skin released on November 12, 2020. He is Toy Freddy's second skin, after VR Toy Freddy in the Arcade Mayhem Event.

Woodland Toy Freddy, being a Toy Freddy skin, is similar. He is made entirely out of wood and is covered in moss. In his head, branches are coming out, replacing his top hat. Woodland Toy Freddy has a large gap within his chest and his limbs are covered in red mushrooms and he holds a large walking stick instead of a microphone.

Boulder Toy Bonnie is a version of Toy Bonnie, and the second forest animatronic skin released on November 19, 2020. He is Toy Bonnie's second skin, after System Error Toy Bonnie in the Arcade Mayhem Event.

entities.name: Heatwave Animatronics
entities.description:
The heatwave animatronics are a series of animatronics based around heat and fire, who appear in Five Nights at Freddy's AR: Special Delivery as limited time animatronic skins. They were introduced for the Sizzling Summer Event that started on July 23, 2020.

Flamethrower Bare Endo is Endo-01's variant and the first heatwave animatronic skin released on July 23, 2020. It is also Endo-01's first skin.

Flamethrower Bare Endo is a dark brown color, compared to Bare Endo, and parts of its body's metal glows in the extreme heat it produces. It wears an angular welding mask over its head, with a rectangular glass visor that shows its blue eyes. The rest of its face is unchanged besides the mask, as seen when pulling the mask up in its workshop animation and its jumpscare. Its left hand has been replaced with a flamethrower, as its name implies. The flamethrower constantly spews flame in the workshop, and is connected to two fuel tanks in Flamethrower Endo's back through a thick brown cable. Said tanks are both ovular shaped, and connected through multiple pipes; a large one at the top and four smaller ones in the bottom. The tank is connected to Flamethrower Bare Endo through three straps of bolted on metal, two vertical across the shoulders and one horizontal across the torso.

Broiler Baby, also known as Stove Baby in the files, is a variant of Circus Baby and the second heatwave animatronic skin released on July 30th, 2020. She is Circus Baby's first skin, not counting 8-Bit Baby.

entities.name: Holiday Animatronics
entities.description:
The holiday animatronics are seasonal animatronic skins that were introduced in Five Nights at Freddy's AR: Special Delivery on March 12, 2020 with the release of Shamrock Freddy.

They are counterparts that bear some identical resemblance to the original animatronics, albeit designed with special traits based on holidays, chronologically including St. Patrick's Day, Easter, and Day of the Dead.

Shamrock Freddy is a St. Patrick's Day variant of Freddy, and appeared in the 2020 St. Patrick's Day event on March 12, 2020, then later on October 1, 2020 for the second round of the mashup event, and once again on March 15, 2021. He is Freddy's first custom skin and officially the very first skin ever released.

Shamrock Freddy's suit is recolored green, along with his pupils being green instead of blue. His top hat is replaced with a leprechaun's hat that has a four leaf clover attached to it. He also has a necklace made of gold beads and an entirely golden microphone.

entities.name: July 4th Animatronics
entities.description:
The are July 4th-themed animatronics that were introduced in Five Nights at Freddy's AR: Special Delivery for the July 4th event that started on June 25, 2020.

They are counterparts that bear some identical resemblance to the original animatronics, albeit designed with special traits based on 4th of July.

Firework Freddy is a July 4th-themed variant of Freddy Fazbear and added on June 25, 2020 as the July 4th event's first skin. He is Freddy's second released skin, after Shamrock Freddy.

Firework Freddy's suit keeps the brown skin and blue eyes of his original counterpart, alongside his bow-tie which has been recolored red instead of black. He has white shades on top of his head alongside his top hat being repainted with the colors of the American flag. Firework Freddy is clothed in a tank-top that's mostly blue with bits of white due to age. Its once again decorated with the American flag's white stars and red/white stripes. He carries a large red and white striped firework with a blue tip, and the string has already been lit.

entities.name: Scary Tales Animatronics
entities.description:
The Scary Tales animatronics are animatronic skin sets that appear in Five Nights at Freddy's AR: Special Delivery and became available for the Scary Tales Event on April 19, 2021.

Both animatronics share the same recycled models as the classic animatronics, with designs based directly on the fairy tale Little Red Riding Hood.

Little Red Chica is Chica's Scary Tales skin released on April 19, 2021. She is Chica's third skin, after Scorching Chica and Liberty Chica. She is based on Little Red Riding Hood, the titular character from the fairy tale of the same name.

Little Red Chica's plush suit is colored white, albeit rotten with black sludge all over it. Her eyes glow a bright orange-yellow hue, and her beak remains the same color, but withered with gray rust. A scratch mark can be seen on the right side of her beak. Little Red Chica's entire mid-section is destroyed and her endoskeleton is exposed, although the damage done to her frame is mostly covered by the red hood she's wearing. The cloak itself has several large tears in it, while the hood remains mostly intact, hanging over Little Red Chica's head. Her pants are also torn apart. She wears brown shoes with one buckle holding the shoes together.

entities.name: Screampunk Animatronics
entities.description:
The screampunk animatronics are steampunk-themed animatronic skin sets that appear in Five Nights at Freddy's AR: Special Delivery and became available for the Screampunk Event on June 24, 2021.

The Screampunk animatronics' design is themed around gears and machinery in a steampunk style.

Clockwork Ballora is Ballora's screampunk skin released on June 24, 2021. She is Ballora's second skin, after Arctic Ballora.

Clockwork Ballora's suit is comprised almost entirely out of golden gears, alongside brown patches that color her eyelids, eyebrows, nose, ears, cheeks and several patches of her arms. Unlike her other counterparts, Clockwork Ballora doesn't appear to have any lipstick around her mouth. Her tiara is also brown with a large golden gear attached to it. There are more gears of different proportions stuck to her elbows, shoulders and legs. The biggest gear of them all comprises her ballerina tutu, even having more smaller gears within it. Her ballerina bikini is gray while her dress and slippers are brown.

entities.name: Valentine Animatronics
entities.description:
The are Valentine's Day-themed animatronics that were introduced in Five Nights at Freddy's AR: Special Delivery for the Heart Stoppers event that started on February 4, 2021.

They are counterparts that bear some identical resemblance to the original animatronics, albeit designed with special traits based on Valentine's Day.

Heartsick Baby is Circus Baby's Valentines Day variant, added on February 4, 2021. She is Circus Baby's second skin, after Broiler Baby.

Heartsick Baby's hair, dress, skirt and shoes are recolored to a purple-pink color. She has black eyes and red pupils. Her cheek buttons are turned magenta and are reshaped to look like hearts, with more heart emblems on both her knees and shoes. The scooper on her belly now has a heart-shaped hole accompanying it. Heartsick Baby's design is akin to the famous Valentine's Day mascot Cupid, having black angel wings on her back, along with a black bow and arrow which she holds on opposing hands. There are also two arrows that appear to have been shot into Heartsick Baby's legs. There's also small tears on her face, legs and skirt.

entities.name: Wasteland Animatronics
entities.description:
The wasteland animatronics are radioactive-themed animatronics who appeared in Five Nights at Freddy's AR: Special Delivery as limited time-only custom skins for the animatronics. They were introduced for the Wasteland Event that started on June 11, 2020, and there are only two animatronics available.

They share nearly-identical models as their pre-existing counterparts, Foxy and Springtrap. The wasteland animatronics' designs are varied, sporting features based on the effects of nuclear infections and mutations, hence their name.

Radioactive Foxy is the first wasteland animatronic skin released on June 11, 2020. He is Foxy's first skin.

His appearance glows with brilliant green colors and a yellow/green aura. He has a single glowing yellow eye for the left socket and lacks an eye-patch to expose an empty right eye-socket. He sports two hooks on his right hand, and are larger and curvier than the normal Foxy's hook. His body is also very transparent, to the point that his endoskeleton is almost visible.

entities.name: Wicked Tides Animatronics
entities.description:
The Wicked Tides animatronics are animatronic skin sets that appeared in Five Nights at Freddy's AR: Special Delivery and became available for the Wicked Tides Event on May 20, 2021.

The Wicked Tides animatronics have appearances themed around the sea and are mutated, humanoid versions of sea creatures.

Dark Water Endo is Endo-01's Wicked Tides skin released on May 20, 2021. It is Endo-01's second skin, after Flamethrower Endo.

Dark Water Endo is primarily based on the species of anglerfish. His entire body glows a luminescent blue with small white tendrils sprouting out of Dark Water Endo's arms. Similarly to actual anglerfish, Dark Water Endo has hollow white eyesockets, large gills for ears, a large puckered lip filled with pointy teeth and a glowlight fin atop his head. He has four fingers per hand and two toes per foot. The hands are a dark black while his fingertips glow white in contrast. The center of his body has a large splash that's mixed with colors of sparkly orange, yellow and purple, which is also covered somewhat by white lines.

entities.name: Winter Animatronics
entities.description:
The winter animatronics are types of holiday animatronics based on the season of winter from Five Nights at Freddy's AR: Special Delivery. Freddy Frostbear, the first winter animatronic (and only full non-skin animatronic), was first released on December 25, 2019, while the winter animatronic skins became available for the Winter Wonderland Event, which started on December 4, 2020.

Based on several pre-existing animatronics, their suits are entirely composed out of ice and snow.

Freddy Frostbear is a Christmas counterpart of Freddy and first appeared on the Christmas update on December 25, 2019 as a separated animatronic with unique AI. He later returned on April 3, 2020 for a little while, and then appeared for the mini event on September 24, 2020 along with several event-exclusive animatronics. Freddy Frostbear returned again during the Winter Wonderland Event for a limited time.

Black Ice Frostbear (Black Ice Freddy Frostbear) is Freddy Frostbear's first skin and added on December 4, 2020 for the Winter Wonderland event.

entities.name: Happy Frog
entities.description:
is an animatronic and a member of the Mediocre Melodies, first appearing in Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator.

Happy Frog is a light green animatronic frog who resembles the designs of the original animatronics from the first game, excluding her top row teeth. She has magenta-colored eyes and yellow accents on her jaw, fingertips, stomach, under both feet, and eyelids. Happy Frog holds a microphone in her right hand, and has a yellow ball attatched to her head by a rod. She has two pairs of buck teeth, green shorts, and an electric box with circuits and wires.

As her quotes from Ultimate Custom Night suggest, Happy Frog is shown to be fun-loving, childlike, and innocent. However, an additional voice in the background is heard during one of Happy Frog's lines, adding extra depth to her motives.

Furthermore, one of her quotes shows that she has a rivalry against Freddy Fazbear to determine who is a better mascot.

entities.name: Mediocre Melodies
entities.description:
The Mediocre Melodies are a group of animatronic entertainers that can be placed within Freddy Fazbear's Pizza Place. They appears to be "legally distinct" versions of characters designed by Fiona Murray (and presumably Fazbear Entertaiment), though the designs would be stolen by Stan and another MCM employee during William Afton's efforts to drive MCM out of business. The two employees would use the stolen schematics to start their own machine shop, Stan's Budget Tech.

They first appeared in Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator as purchasable items from the Stan's Budget Tech Catalog (except for Orville Elephant, who can be afforded from Rare Finds Auction, and Mystic Hippo, who debuted in another game) for customizing the pizzeria. They reappeared in Ultimate Custom Night, Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted 2, and some of them make cameo appearances in Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach.

They are animatronics made of a plastic material, who appear to be of a height similar to the average adult. Their appearance, like most of the animatronics in the series, is based on some animal, but whose bodies have an anthropomorphic shape. A metallic endoskeleton is known to be found underneath these suits, allowing them to move all their joints on stage. This endoskeleton is not seen much during the game, but it can be seen that it has a row of teeth and several characteristics that vary by character; for example, the animatronics who wear hats have their own mechanism that allows them to be lifted in the air; in addition, they seem to have a smaller endoskeleton than the others in the series. These always have a 12V battery nearby, which means they always depend on a limited external power source to function.

Due to their appearances being similar to the Classic Animatronics, they presumably have similar or equal functionality.

entities.name: Mr. Hippo
entities.description:
is an animatronic and a member of the Mediocre Melodies. He makes his first debut in Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator.

Mr. Hippo is a short and purple hippopotamus animatronic with lavender accents around his muzzle, belly, and eye sockets. He was modeled after the original animatronics from the first game. He has blue eyes, four teeth from the bottom jaw, and a black top hat. On his chest is a flower with red petals and a yellow center, and there are two black buttons below that.

He has an electricity power source box which has circuits and wires to activate him just like the other mid-size animatronics.

Mr. Hippo's personality resembles that of a grandfatherly advice giver. His lines in Ultimate Custom Night mention that he is good friends with Orville Elephant. He has a habit of rambling for long periods of time. He is also shown at times to be philosophical as evident by his diatribes in Ultimate Custom Night. He speaks with a Boston/New York mixed accent.

entities.name: Nedd Bear
entities.description:
is an animatronic and a member of the Mediocre Melodies. He makes his first debut in Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator.

Nedd Bear is a light brown animatronic bear with tan accents around his muzzle, eye sockets, palms, under both feet, and belly. He resembles the designs of the original animatronics from the first game, specifically Freddy Fazbear. He has droopy green eyes, a red tie with diagonal white stripes, and a red flat hat attached to his head by a spring. If one looks carefully, he has a visible endoskeleton mouth similar to the ones seen in the first game.

Nedd Bear's personality is that of a wisecracking hillbilly. Scott Cawthon describes him as goofy, as well as often failing to realize the severity of his actions while also quipping silly one liners. This also suggests that he is also somewhat inept of his surroundings. He speaks using an Arkansas accent. A feminine voice in the background is heard in one of his quotes, painting an entirely different picture.

In Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator, like the rest of the Melodies, Nedd Bear has an electrical power source box that is needed to activate him.

entities.name: Orville Elephant
entities.description:
Orville is an orange animatronic elephant with lighter accents on his trunk, inner ears, his torso, hoof toes, and around his blue eyes. He has teeth on his bottom jaw. He wears a purple top hat with a white stripe at the base, and has two black buttons on his chest. Similar to Mr. Hippo, Orville has a large flower on his chest, but the petals are purple and they have a red center. He holds a black wand with a white tip in his left hand.

Like the rest of the Melodies, he has an electrical power source box that activates him along with his fellow animatronics.

Orville seems over-dramatic with his voice being full of dramatic flair. He also speaks using an upper class London accent. As evident by Mr. Hippo's diatribes in Ultimate Custom Night, Orville tends to be easily confused. One of his lines suggests reclusiveness. A feminine voice is heard in the background of one of his quotes, painting an entirely different picture.

Despite him and Mr. Hippo being good friends, it's unknown why Orville never mentions Mr. Hippo in his lines and how Orville could have mentioned a side of Mr. Hippo's personality that's unknown about, a similar technique of how Mr. Hippo mentioned a side of Orville's personality that was unknown about but was later made vociferous.

entities.name: Pigpatch
entities.description:
is an animatronic and a member of the Mediocre Melodies, making his first appearance in Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator.

Pigpatch is a pink animatronic pig with light pink accents on his snout, inner ears, torso, and on the bottom of his feet. A pink belly button can be seen on his torso, as well a spiral tail on back of his buttocks. Similar to Happy Frog, Pigpatch has a different colored pelvis and upper legs, resembling actual pants. He has two short tusks from the bottom jaw and rosy red cheeks. He also has a right green eye and a left blue eye, referencing heterochromia iridum. Being the only Mediocre Melodies member to play an instrument, Pigpatch carries a brown banjo with tan accents.

Like the rest of the Melodies, he has an electrical power source box that activates him along with his fellow animatronics.

In Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted 2, his eyes are more sunken and yellow. His pupils are also drastically smaller.

entities.name: Adventure Animatronics
entities.description:
The adventure animatronics are the main characters of FNaF World, being smaller, childish and colorful versions of the animatronics of the original saga.

The Adventure Animatronics look like smaller, repaired, cute, and childish versions of animatronics that appeared from the four core series games. Some like Withered Chica, Springtrap, Foxy, etc. seem to be more repaired and in better condition, without neglecting some "withered" characteristics in the respective characters.

The player can select two teams of four animatronics each (eight in total), which can be chosen while out of combat, as well as being able to level up as they gain experience after each combat.

Each animatronic has three different attacks with different effects depending on the color with which they are marked. For example, pink attacks heal, red attacks deal damage to all enemies, yellow attacks deal damage to a single enemy, black attacks insta-kill enemies. But each member of the team will have to wait for their turn to attack, and these can vary. Each Adventure has its own combination of attacks and some share the same.

entities.description:
The Balloon animatronics are a set of animatronic counterparts seemingly themed off of Balloon Boy, and exclusively appeared as marketable Five Nights at Freddy's products since their debut in Fall 2022 by Seven Times Six.

Balloon Freddy is Freddy Fazbear's counterpart with a red and blue-colored propeller hat and shirt, blue pants and is holding a blue balloon. He is available as a plush toy, figure, and Funko POP!

Balloon Bonnie is Bonnie the Rabbit's counterpart with a pink and red-colored propeller hat and shirt, blue pants, and is holding a pink balloon. He is available as a figure and Funko POP!

Balloon Chica is Chica the Chicken's counterpart with a purple and red-colored propeller hat and shirt, blue pants, and is holding a purple balloon. She is available as a figure and Funko POP!

The Bootleg animatronics are a set of animatronic counterparts themed off of bootleg Five Nights at Freddy's merchandise that debuted in Fall 2022 by Seven Times Six, with Bootleg Freddy. In 2023, Bootleg Foxy would appear as a boss in Freddy in Space 3: Chica in Space. Bonnie and Chica would debut in 2025 in the Five Nights at Freddy's Stickerpedia book by Scholastic Corp.

Bootleg Freddy is Freddy Fazbear's counterpart with a large, goofy grin with messed up teeth, a tilted bowtie, his hat placed far back on his head, and messy stitching.

Bootleg Bonnie is Bonnie the Rabbit's counterpart that is a pinkish-purple with a sad expression, pointy ears, and a red banjo.

Bootleg Chica is Chica the Chicken's counterpart with a clueless expression, three tuffs of hair, and a white bib with green and blue polka dots and the misspelling "Chika."

entities.name: Classic Animatronics
entities.description:
The Classic animatronics are the local robot entertainers of Freddy Fazbear's Pizza and the very first animatronics to be introduced in the Five Nights at Freddy's series. The group consists of four animatronic animals: Freddy Fazbear, Bonnie the Rabbit, Chica the Chicken, and Foxy the Pirate. Their first prototypes were commissioned by Fazbear Entertainment to be built by Edwin Murray in the 1970s. However, due to him going "missing," the project was picked up and finished by Henry Emily.

The animatronics first appeared in the original Five Nights at Freddy's game as the main antagonists, then returned in Five Nights at Freddy's 2 as old and broken iterations referred to as Withered animatronics. While appearing in Five Nights at Freddy's 3, Five Nights at Freddy's 4, Sister Location, Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator, Security Breach, Help Wanted 2 and Secret of the Mimic as cameos, they returned in Ultimate Custom Night, Help Wanted, and Special Delivery as prominent antagonists. They've also appeared in the novel trilogy, Fazbear Frights series, Tales from the Pizzaplex series, Interactive Novel series, and the film series. The Fazbear Fanverse also feature their own iterations of the Classics, those being in POPGOES and Five Nights at Freddy's Plus.

The Classic animatronics use a very simple design, with suits are made of fabric and filled with crossbeams, wires and other animatronic parts placed on metal endoskeletons. Giving the impression of cartoon animals, they wear accessories and have four fingers per hand. They also have a single set of teeth on the lower jaw, with the exception of Foxy, who also has teeth on the upper jaw. Said teeth are square in the cases of Freddy and Chica, but are round for Bonnie and sharp & triangular for Foxy.

In the first game, the animatronics supposedly wander about Freddy Fazbear's Pizza after-hours in a "free-roaming mode" (due to their servos locking up if they stay in place for too long) and sometimes coming after the protagonist Mike Schmidt. This is confirmed by Ralph during his call on Night 1.

entities.name: Endoskeletons
entities.description:
are the inner structural frames of the animatronic characters and the S.T.A.F.F. robots seen throughout the Five Nights at Freddy's franchise.

The endoskeletons were mostly created as skeletons for the robots, composing of many mechanical parts and animatronic devices including wiring, eye and mouth pieces, moving limbs and digits, and voice boxes, all of which come together to make a bipedal humanoid animatronic.

The endoskeletons are housed inside character-themed suits, thus bringing the animatronics to life for the patrons of restaurants hosted by Fazbear Entertainment (Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, Freddy Fazbear's Mega Pizzaplex, etc.) as well as allowing them to roam around the establishment at night.

The endoskeletons are one of the driving points of the game as they are what gets the player killed - not the physical endoskeleton, per se, but the animatronics' confusion of it with the player. According to the rules of the establishment, an endoskeleton is not to be seen outside their suit, so the animatronics are programmed to forcefully stuff any exposed endoskeletons into a Freddy Fazbear suit. At night, they will confuse the player for an endoskeleton and stuff them in a suit, which is filled with wires and crossbeams, as mentioned by Phone Guy, ultimately resulting in death, which the game over screen clearly shows. This does not appear to be the case in other further installments after the first two games.

entities.name: Funtime Animatronics
entities.description:
The Funtime animatronics are advanced animatronic models and attractions of Circus Baby's Entertainment and Rental and, previously, Circus Baby's Pizza World.

They first appeared in Five Nights at Freddy's: Sister Location as the main antagonists. Some of them returned in Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator, Ultimate Custom Night, Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted, Five Nights at Freddy's AR: Special Delivery and Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted 2. Some of them also make cameo appearances in Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach. Various Funtime animatronics appear in the Original Novel Trilogy, the Fazbear Frights series, the Tales from the Pizzaplex series, and the film series.

The Funtime animatronics have highly-upgraded models and detailed endoskeletons, with rosy cheeks of a red-and-purple and a palette of colors among which white, pink and purple protrude. Additionally, they feature small seams in their bodies that split parts of their suits into plates, allowing them to swivel open (especially the faces).

The Funtime animatronics possess advanced A.I., created and designed by Afton Robotics, LLC for Fazbear Entertainment, Inc. It is revealed that the Funtime animatronics each have roles in capturing and subsequently murdering children. It is also indicated through their dialogue that they, much like other animatronics in the franchise, are self-aware.

entities.name: Glamrock Animatronics
entities.description:
The are revamped, glam rock-themed characters from Freddy Fazbear's Mega Pizzaplex. They appear in Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach, its RUIN DLC, and Help Wanted 2 as primary antagonists, with the exception of Glamrock Freddy, who serves as a deuteragonist in the base game, and later Roxanne Wolf, who reforms into a minor supporting ally by the end of RUIN.

Out of the main four animatronics, two were based on their original counterparts. The Glamrock animatronics feature a much more anthropomorphic design than previous characters and wear punk accessories with an '80s theme, namely face paints, oversized shoulder pads, mildly-spiky bracelets, and other types of jewelry.

The Glamrock animatronics were made to function as the mascots for Freddy Fazbear's Mega Pizzaplex. Their technology appears to be relatively advanced, as they are capable of moving around freely, unlike typical animatronics that only move on a set pattern, and each seems to have a highly advanced A.I. and self-awareness, as they are capable of holding and starting conversations without set replies and grasp almost complete free will.

Almost all of the glamrocks, except Freddy in the base game, and later Roxy near the end of the RUIN DLC, are corrupted/controlled by Vanny, Glitchtrap, and The Entity (RUIN DLC), and therefore are directed to kill both Gregory and Cassie. Each main animatronic has a unique function: Glamrock Freddy is able to open his stomach in a manner akin to the Funtime Animatronics, allowing for Gregory to take shelter from the threats in the pizzaplex. Montgomery Gator has special claws to open particular gates with, Glamrock Chica has a special voice box that can produce a loud shriek, while Roxanne Wolf has terrific eyes that allow her to see through walls.

entities.name: Halloween Animatronics
entities.description:
The Halloween animatronics are Halloween variants of mainly Nightmare Animatronics (and some other animatronics such as Daycare Attendant) from throughout the core series. First appearing in Five Nights at Freddy's 4: Halloween Edition.

They also returned in Ultimate Custom Night, Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted, Five Nights at Freddy's AR: Special Delivery and Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted 2.

Most of the Halloween Animatronics are variants of the Nightmare Animatronics. They are based off Halloween themed characters and decorations, namely jack-o-lanterns, trick-or-treaters, and Frankenstein's Monster.

Unlike the Nightmare Animatronics, the Halloween Animatronics may not be hallucinations and instead characters made by Glitchtrap and Fazbear Entertainment for the VR Games. If this is true, it means that none of the Halloween Animatronics physically existed. In the games, however, they appear to function similarly to their pre-existing counterparts.

entities.name: Hardmode Animatronics
entities.description:
The hardmode animatronics are recolored animatronic counterparts who appeared in Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted, exclusive to blacklight modes.

Their appearance is exactly the same to the original counterparts, except reskinned with different textures to reflect the blacklight modes.

Dark Freddy is the hardmode counterpart of the original Freddy Fazbear colored in pitch black saving for the white glowing eyes and teeth, reminiscent to the original Shadow Freddy from Five Nights at Freddy's 2.

In the blacklight mode of Freddy's level from the Parts and Service mode, he serves as the original Freddy's replacement with the same functions. Dark Freddy appears alongside dark versions of Nightmare Freddy's Freddles, who appear on top above Dark Freddy at the beginning of the round. One of them ends up glitching and briefly replaces the watch that is required to be removed from the circuitry of Freddy's chest.
entities.short_description: The hardmode animatronics are recolored animatronic counterparts who appeared in Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted, exclusive to blacklight modes.

entities.name: Nightmare Animatronics
entities.description:
The Nightmare animatronics are heavily withered, exaggeratedly monstrous animatronics. They reside in a fake house connected to Circus Baby's Entertainment and Rental.

They first appeared in Five Nights at Freddy's 4 and returned in Ultimate Custom Night (with the exception of Nightmare Foxy), Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted (with the exception of Nightmare and Nightmare Mangle) and Five Nights at Freddy's AR: Special Delivery (with Plushtrap being the only Nightmare animatornic to be added to the game). They also appeared in the Tales from the Pizzaplex series.

Alongside the Twisted animatronics from the Novel Trilogy's universe, the Nightmare animatronics appear as the most menacing out of all animatronic classes.

Most of the Nightmare animatronics are featured with a deteriorated appearance with a big series of rips and holes all over, sporting a total of ten fingers with spike-like claws/nails, an excessive amount of long dangerously sharp teeth (found in both the structure of the animatronics and the endoskeletons), and small metallic eyes. Their endoskeleton heads look suspiciously similar to that of a human skull, with a line of indentations down their forehead.
entities.short_description: The Nightmare animatronics are heavily withered, exaggeratedly monstrous animatronics. They reside in a fake house connected to Circus Baby's Entertainment and Rental.

entities.name: Phantom Animatronics
entities.description:
The Phantom animatronics are hallucination variants of the Classic, Withered, and Toy animatronics who haunt the security guard of Fazbear's Fright: The Horror Attraction throughout the week.

The Phantom animatronics first appeared in Five Nights at Freddy's 3 as the secondary antagonists. They returned in Ultimate Custom Night (with the exception of Phantom Foxy and Phantom Puppet) and Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted (with the exception of Phantom Chica and Phantom Puppet).

The Phantom animatronics are burnt and damaged ghost-like entities based on the animatronics from the first two games, with greenish hues and charred colors. Their dark color tones make these variants almost blend in with the backgrounds, as well as making them hardly noticeable, especially when viewing the security cameras. All of the Phantom animatronics have empty black eyes with grayish-colored irises and glowing white pupils.

The Phantoms originate in the player's mind due to lack of air from ventilation and the creepy atmosphere of Fazbear's Fright. They will appear at random on certain cameras or simply in the office. If one is to witness a Phantom they will jumpscare the player, but due to being hallucinations, they are non-lethal, before disappearing in a flash of light to either disable their ventilation or merely act as distractions which makes it harder to keep track of Springtrap.
entities.short_description: The Phantom animatronics are hallucination variants of the Classic, Withered, and Toy animatronics who haunt the security guard of Fazbear's Fright: The Horror Attraction throughout the week.

entities.name: Puppet Animatronics
entities.description:
The Puppet animatronics are a set of marionette-themed animatronic counterparts, and exclusively appeared as marketable Five Nights at Freddy's products since their debut in Spring 2025 by Scholastic Corp. Their first and currently only appearance has been in the Five Nights at Freddy's Stickerpedia.

Puppet Bonnie is Bonnie the Rabbit's counterpart with strong inspiration from the Puppet. He has a white mask with red-pink tears, red cheeks, white ears with red inner ears, and buck teeth. He has a white bowtie, two white buttons on his chest, and white circles around his wrists and ankles.

Puppet Chica is Chica the Chicken's counterpart with strong inspiration from the Puppet and Toy Chica. She has a white mask on, with purple tears, red lipstick, and red cheeks. She has two white buttons on her chest and white circles around her wrists and ankles.

Puppet Foxy is Foxy the Pirate's counterpart with strong inspiration from the Puppet. He has a white mask on with yellow tears, red cheeks, and a missing ear. He has two white buttons on his chest and white circles around his wrists, ankles, and tail.

entities.name: Puppet Crew
entities.description:
The were a group of puppet-like animatronics, first appearing in Five Nights at Freddy's: Secret of the Mimic within the Theater.

They appear to be mechanically controlled puppets with built-in voice boxes. They will jumpscare the player if Arnold misses too many of the targets.

Roxy was made by Fiona Murray to give to her son, David Sean Murray, on his first birthday. The rest of the Puppet Crew were presumably made Fiona to have perform in Edwin Murray's Stage Manager software to investors. They are an automatic puppet show that is operated by an employee with a Springlock suit.

During the events of Secret of the Mimic, Arnold builds the Pirate Captain Springlock suit, and is sent into the Theater to operate the show. He has to shoot targets to progress the show forward. After Arnold is progressing though, the area starts falling apart, leading to an unstable environment. Once the show is completed, the Captain's stage platform collapses and Arnold falls with it on.

entities.name: Rockstar Animatronics
entities.description:
The Rockstar Animatronics are another set of revamped animatronic models from the Freddy Fazbear's Pizza Place location by Fazbear Entertainment.

They first appeared in Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator as purchasable items from the Smiles and Servos, Inc Catalog (except for Lefty, who can be afforded from Rare Finds Auction, and Carnie, who debuted in another game) for customizing the pizzeria. They would later make reappearances in Ultimate Custom Night and Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted 2.

The rockstar animatronics seem to be based off the classic animatronics in their withered forms. They all have heads separated from the jaws, sporting round rosy or blue cheeks (except Rockstar Foxy), metal stars on their chests (except for Rockstar Chica who wears a bib, and Carnie who wears a suit), and equip instruments.

While full details of their artificial intelligence are not revealed, it is possible that the rockstar animatronics have their own unique functions, like Rockstar Freddy designed as a Faz-Coin bank seen in Ultimate Custom Night.

entities.name: S.T.A.F.F. Bots
entities.description:
The S.T.A.F.F. Bots are employee robots made by Fazbear Entertainment LLC for Freddy Fazbear's Mega Pizzaplex. They first appeared in Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach.

While all S.T.A.F.F. Bots vary in color scheme depending on their role, they all share the same basic design. A S.T.A.F.F. bots sports a white, ovoid-esque head, with cutouts for two white eyes with black irises; two ovals are placed on the sides of their head. A light gray, pointed decal is placed under each cutout, and a segment runs through the middle of the eye sockets. Their faces also appear to have peach pink blush circles, below their eyes. Their torso is composed of a singular, segmented metal spine, with a chest suit piece, fitted with buttons, covering half of it. The word "STAFF" is painted on the back of the chest piece, and two wires poke out of both sides of the chestpiece's lower half, which connect to their respective arm. Spherical shoulder joints connect the arms to the torso, the upper half of the arms are bare, and while the lower half is covered by a forearm suit piece, the arms end in three-fingered hands. A cylindrical waist connects both halves of the S.T.A.F.F. bot, with lights on the sides. The lower half of the S.T.A.F.F. bot is made up of one singular piece that tapers outwards, ending in two wheels.

S.T.A.F.F. bots perform jobs normally done by humans around the Pizzaplex, and can be seen working as waiters, security guards, and janitors. Most of their variants are passive, and will not attempt to hurt the player. However, Alpha/Nightmarionne S.T.A.F.F. bots will attack the player on contact, while Security Bots will alert nearby animatronics to the player's position by sounding an alarm. Cleaner Bots also alert animatronics, but only if the player gets in the way of the cleaning arm. If there are no hostile animatronics nearby, the alarm may cause one to teleport one near the player.

The Security Bots patrol Freddy Fazbear's Mega Pizzaplex during the night. These S.T.A.F.F. Bots are the most common throughout the game, and follow set patrol routes, occasionally stopping and performing a full turn before resuming their rounds. Should Gregory come within the beam of light, the Security Bot will jumpscare him and sound an alarm, alerting nearby Glamrock Animatronics to his position. In the Sewers below the Pizzaplex, a withered version of the Security Bot (not the Nightmarionne ones) is present, called Sewer Bots in the game files.
entities.short_description: The S.T.A.F.F. Bots are employee robots made by Fazbear Entertainment LLC for Freddy Fazbear's Mega Pizzaplex. They first appeared in Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach.

entities.name: Shadow Animatronics
entities.description:
The Shadow animatronics are ghost-like entities with an unknown place of origin, whereabouts, and history functions. Shadow Freddy and RWQFSFASXC are the only two recurring animatronics from throughout the series.

The Shadow animatronics debuted in Five Nights at Freddy's 2 as Easter egg characters. They later appeared in Five Nights at Freddy's 3, Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator, Ultimate Custom Night, Help Wanted, Special Delivery, and Security Breach as minor characters/antagonists. They've also appeared in the Fazbear Frights and the film series. The Fazbear Fanverse also feature their own iterations of the Shadows, those being in Five Nights at Candy's and One Night at Flumpty's.

The Shadow animatronics lack solid forms as they appear as shadowy, supernatural specters with forms based on the Fazbear Entertainment animatronics. Most of them have very dark colors, while sporting glowing white eyes and teeth.

A Shadow counterpart based on Toy Bonnie. He first appeared in Five Nights at Freddy's 2, where he spawns inside the office.

entities.name: Spring Colorway Animatronics
entities.description:
The spring colorway animatronics are animatronic variant sets that appear exclusively as Five Nights at Freddy's merchandise.

They appear similar to the blacklight animatronics except with lighter "spring" colors. They were only sold as plushies in both normal and jumbo size.

Spring Colorway Freddy is Freddy Fazbear's counterpart.

Spring Colorway Foxy is Foxy's counterpart.

entities.name: Springlock Suits
entities.description:
The springlock suits, springlock hybrids, or springlock animatronics are unique but currently discontinued machinery in the Five Nights at Freddy's series. They are suits that function as animatronics and costumes in each different mode, which can be switched back and forth by using a crank which winds up the suit. This allows the mechanical gears surrounding the body of the wearer to deactivate, allowing the wearer to slip in-between them. If the suit activates whilst the wearer is inside of it, they will spin inwards and the wearer will be bludgeoned severely, causing them to be crushed and killed.

The springlock suits are composed of several individual spring-powered locking mechanisms, hence their name. When one wishes to change a springlock suit from its animatronic form into its suit form, they must insert a hand crank into its designated slot and proceed to turn it firmly into position. Doing so will proceed to coil the springs into their suit positions, causing the endoskeleton parts to be compressed and locked around the sides.

When operating a suit, one must be careful not to touch or lubricate any of the springlocks and keep them tightly wound. If these requirements are not met, the wearer of the suit has little chance of survival; the springlocks will come loose and the endoskeleton parts will rapidly recoil inwards, thus impaling the suit's user and causing a slow, painful death.

From the various springlock suit appearances, one can gather that this event has taken place at least twice within the history of the franchise. One event was the death of William Afton, as depicted in the end-of-night minigames of the third game. The other was mentioned by Ralph, being a "springlock failure". Little-to-no context is given as to this event, so it is mostly regarded as speculation. It is unknown if The Big Bite counts as a springlock failure despite a springlock suit being involved; this could be the incident Ralph mentioned.

entities.name: Stitched Animatronics
entities.description:
The Stitched animatronics are a set of merch-exclusive characters with stitched-up patchwork bodies, making them look like menacing stuffed animals. They have only been featured as stickers in the Five Nights at Freddy's Stickerpedia.

Stitched Freddy is a Freddy variant with a light and dark brown, and light and dark orange patchwork body. His eyes have white irises and he has sharp teeth, and wears a black top hat.

Stitched Bonnie is a Bonnie variant with a light and dark blue and black patchwork body. He has white eyes and sharp teeth, with a green tongue hanging out the side of his mouth. He also wears a red bowtie.

Stitched Chica is a Chica variant with a yellow and orange patchwork body. She has white eyes, sharp teeth, and a white bib that is stitched together but doesn't have any words on it.

entities.name: Tie-Dye Animatronics
entities.description:
Tie-dye animatronics are a set of animatronic counterparts colored in tie-dye textures, and exclusively appeared as marketable Five Nights at Freddy's products since their debut in Summer 2022 by Funko.

Tie-Dye Freddy is Freddy Fazbear's counterpart with a tie-dye color of pink and purple. He is available as an action figure, Funko POP!, and plush toy.

Tie-Dye Bonnie is Bonnie's counterpart with a tie-dye color of purple and periwinkle. He is available as an action figure, Funko POP!, and plush toy.

Tie-Dye Chica is Chica's counterpart with a tie-dye color of yellow and orange. She is available as an action figure, Funko POP!, and plush toy.

entities.name: Toy Animatronics
entities.description:
The Toy animatronics are improved versions of the original animatronics, designed by Fazbear Entertainment to replace the Withered animatronics for the re-opening of Freddy Fazbear's Pizza in November 1987.

The Toy animatronics debut in Five Nights at Freddy's 2 as the main antagonists, along with the Withered animatronics. They later appeared in Five Nights at Freddy's 3, Five Nights at Freddy's 4, and Security Breach as cameos. They returned in Ultimate Custom Night, Help Wanted, and Special Delivery as prominent antagonists. They've also appeared in the film series. The Fazbear Fanverse also feature their own iterations of the Toys, those being in Five Nights at Candy's and POPGOES.

Hence their name, their suit material appears to be made of plastic, as if they were a life-sized toy. While all models notably sport round rosy cheeks, the Toy animatronics are based on the original cast and have bigger eyes, fully functional fingers, wedge-shaped feet, eyelashes, and facial appearances reminiscent of a ventriloquist doll.

Similar to the old Withered animatronics, most of the Toys share the same endoskeleton, which is Endo-02, however, none of them are visibly seen except for Mangle. Three notable exceptions are Balloon Boy and JJ, who have unique endoskeletons, and the Puppet.
entities.short_description: The Toy animatronics are improved versions of the original animatronics, designed by Fazbear Entertainment to replace the Withered animatronics for the re-opening of Freddy Fazbear's Pizza in November 1987.

entities.name: Twisted Animatronics
entities.description:
The Twisted Animatronics are half-organic, half-robotic animatronic-like monsters and counterparts. They appeared in The Twisted Ones as the main antagonists, alongside their creator, William Afton.

The twisted animatronics' design is similar to the nightmare animatronics from the series' main universe but more feral and almost organic-looking. With the Illusion Disc imported, the twisted animatronics has two alternate forms:

Created by Afton Robotics, LLC, the twisted animatronics are designed to lure and kill their victims using Springlock mechanisms. Their Illusion Discs emit high-pitched audio to change the victims' perspective views, making them see the twisted animatronics in a different way depending on their memories. As with the Nightmare Animatronics, the twisted Animatronics seem to have shared personality traits. In this case, they are all subservient purely to their creator, William Afton, but have also exhibited relentlessness when chasing their victims, and ruthlessness when killing them. Although built purely to kill whomsoever Afton tells them to, they have been known to lash out violently whenever provoked.

Twisted Freddy is one of the twisted animatronics and an antagonist in Five Nights at Freddy's: The Twisted Ones. He is the twisted incarnation of Freddy Fazbear, which was created by William Afton to hunt down and kill Charlotte Emily, along with the other twisteds.

entities.name: Welcome Show Animatronics
entities.description:
The Welcome Show animatronics are old, sessile animatronics created by Edwin Murray that first appeared in Five Nights at Freddy's: Secret of the Mimic during the "Demo-tronic Welcome Show" sequence and throughout the game. The are all seen inside the Welcome Show room.

Some of them appear frequently in the game, not as animatronics, but rather as costumes for The Mimic to wear.

The Welcome Show animatronics are part of the Demo-tronic Welcome Show, which are colorful characters, diverse in animal species, occupation, and size. Many of them are seen performing with instruments, some with various themed objects, and others simply are decorative.

None of the animatronics display any form of sentience or awareness, as they are built to follow protocols assigned by an outside user.

entities.name: Withered Animatronics
entities.description:
The Withered animatronics are prototypes and the presumed first versions of the original animatronics that eventually ended up broken and dilapidated.

The Withered animatronics debut in Five Nights at Freddy's 2 as the main antagonists and would later appear in the film series as their own entities.

The Withereds appear as larger, bulkier designs compared to their later counterparts. Their suits are made of a fabric with detached lower jaws and functional fingers and are shown in a dirty state.

They seem to have some shared design details from Endo-02, but with the added functionality of the Springlock mechanisms.

entities.name: Endoskeleton
entities.description:
Endoskeleton, also referred to as Endo, Tina and Arnold, is a recurring Easter egg character seen hidden throughout many scenes in the 2023 film Five Nights at Freddy's.

Endo is a puppet prop provided by Jim Henson's Creature Shop.

Endoskeleton is a Springlock endoskeleton with yellow eyes, a cage-like torso, small ears, claw-like hands, and is noticeably missing the bottom half of its left leg. It also appears to be quite rusty, and it is unknown how long its been out of service.

As a Springlock endo, Endo is capable of having a suit get fitted on it, using the springlock mechanisms to clamp on to the suit, turning the Endo into a character ready for public viewing.

entities.name: Ballora Hologram
entities.description:
is an holographic ballerina who appeared as the main antagonist in Dance with Me, the second story in Fazbear Frights 4: Step Closer.

In Dance with Me, Ballora initially appears as blue and a little fuzzy due to being a hologram. As Kasey continues to wear the glasses, however, her appearance becomes clearer. Ballora has jointed limbs, glowing blue eyes, red lips, a white face, and long, blue-painted fingernails. Her painted face appears clown-like, although hers isn't smiling, and her empty eyes don't blink. Ballora's face is split down the middle.

Ballora never speaks, but her personality is shown through her actions. Like the Blackbird, she stalks Kasey until she makes things right. She seems to become increasingly agitated when Kasey continues her life of crime, and is haunting Kasey for her past misdeeds, as shown in the dream sequence.

Ballora isn't physically present in Dance With Me. She is only seen whenever the protagonist, Kasey, wears a special pair of glasses. The glasses has Ballora's image on it, and the words "Put on the glasses, and Ballora will dance for you." Every time Kasey puts it on, she sees a holographic image of an animatronic ballerina whom she recognizes as Ballora from Circus Baby's Pizza World. She doesn't actively attack Kasey, but simply twirls around and creeps her out, seemingly getting closer every time she wears the glasses. One time, she sees Ballora twirling in amongst the falling autumn leaves, but for some reason, they were revolving around her, as if she was physically present. Eventually, Ballora gets so close to Kasey that she could almost touch her. After Kasey gives the glasses back to the mother and daughter of whom she stole from, the daughter puts them on. Not only can she see Ballora, she also begins to dance ballet.

entities.name: Baron von Bear
entities.description:
Baron Von Bear is one of the animatronics performing on stage at the Pizza Playground. When a little girl enters inside the pizzeria with her parents, she sees Baron Von Bear in his dormant state. She asks Porter if he's gonna sing, and he informs her the show is expected to begin in 15 minutes. Towards the end of the story, a large batch of children watch a stage performance by Baron Von Bear and an unspecified bird animatronic, which they seem to enjoy.

entities.name: Bonnie the Rabbit
entities.description:
Bonnie is an animatronic rabbit and a minor character in the Fazbear Frights book series. He is the guitarist of the animatronic band at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza.

Bonnie is a blue animatronic rabbit with a lighter shade of indigo on both his stomach, inner ears and muzzle, and red eyes. He wears a red bowtie. He has thin black eyebrows with a slightly rounded head similar to Withered Bonnie.

Bonnie first appears performing on stage alongside Freddy and Chica in 1985, back when Jeff's Pizza was Freddy Fazbear's Pizza instead. Earlier on, Oswald absentmindedly drew animatronics, one of which was a bunny, most likely Bonnie himself.

Bonnie appears alongside Freddy, Chica, and Foxy in the abandoned Freddy Fazbear location.

entities.name: Chica the Chicken
entities.description:
Chica is a character and a backup singer of Freddy Fazbear's Pizza's animatronic band in the Fazbear Frights book series. She serves as the main antagonist of Coming Home, the third story in Fazbear Frights 4: Step Closer.

Chica's appearance is similar to her original counterpart, as she is a bright yellow man-sized animatronic chick. She has pinkish-purplish eyes, big black eyebrows, and orange feet. However, Chica also has sharp teeth. A big white bib hangs around her neck, which says "Let's Eat!" Sometimes, Chica is mentioned to hold a cupcake with eyes, two buck teeth, and a candle.

Chica first appears performing on stage alongside Freddy and Bonnie in 1985, back when Jeff's Pizza was Freddy Fazbear's Pizza instead. Earlier on, Oswald absentmindedly drew animatronics, one of which was a chicken, most likely Chica herself.

Chica appears alongside Freddy, Bonnie, and Foxy in an abandoned Freddy Fazbear location.

entities.name: Coils the Birthday Clown
entities.description:
is an animatronic in Jump for Tickets, the second story of Fazbear Frights 9: The Puppet Carver.

Coils the Birthday Clown animatronic has wonky eyes, with one that seems to look straight while the other veers down and to the right, and a weird, open-jawed grin. Its lightweight lanky body is dressed in a lemon-and-lime-colored striped costume decorated with little jingly bells. Coils’s name comes from its arms, which are yellow stretchy coils. It has three-fingered, white-gloved hands. Coils wears big green clown shoes.

After Colton is killed by the Ticket Pulverizer, Coils the Birthday Clown’s comically huge grin changes to a downturned mouth and sad-looking eyes which Ted, an employee, thinks he sees a tear running down.

Coils is the main attraction of the Ticket Pulverizer game in Freddy Fazbear's Pizza. It is responsible for announcing the countdown before the game would start. Colton came across it during his cousin Aidan's birthday party when he was invited to play the game. He noticed that the game gave more tickets to younger kids rather than other kids, and plans to rewire it to make it more fair.

entities.name: Eleanor
entities.description:
is the main antagonist of the Fazbear Frights anthology novel series, first appearing in To Be Beautiful, the second story of Fazbear Frights 1: Into the Pit. She is also (presumably) the overarching antagonist of Frailty from the Tales from the Pizzaplex series, and a secret minigame character in Five Nights at Freddy's: Into the Pit,

With her origins shrouded in mystery, Eleanor is a dark chaotic force who feeds off human suffering and agony.

Eleanor is said to look like a supermodel, a metallic mannequin, and a doll. She's a few inches taller than Sarah and her long, slender, and elegant limbs and tiny waist are jointed. Eleanor's hands are little and white. She has wide, big, and green long-lashed eyes, pink Cupid's bow lips, and pink circles on her cheeks which makes her pretty face appear clown-like. Eleanor has sparse red hair pulled up into twin pigtails on top of her head, and her lightweight body is sleek and silver with a long neck and a rounded bust and hips. When Sarah finds her at the junkyard she is a little tarnished and dusty, but she manages to clean her off and finds an on-off switch at the small of her back. Eleanor wears a short skirt and footwear which exposes her toes. As revealed to Sarah in a dream, Eleanor has a mouthful of large, sharp and jagged teeth. Just below her throat is a cartoonish heart-shaped button.

When examined by Everett Larson, however, Eleanor is said to have a skeletal face, as if a thin layer of diseased gray skin is being stretched over her metal skull. Her face is painted garishly with a candy-apple-red mouth and pink cheeks, giving her a hideous clown-like appearance. Eleanor has large, deep-set eyes that are dark pits, and her mouth can stretch impossibly wide. Her twin pigtails are said to be bizarrely childish. Instead of a button, Eleanor has a weird cartoonish heart pendant around her neck which pulses and glows blood red. Gooey black tendrils made of blood shoot from her mouth, nose, fingers, and toes.

entities.name: Ella
entities.description:
Ella is a miniature doll-like animatronic who first appears as the main antagonist of 1:35 A.M., the first story in the book of the same name, and then as a cameo character in the epilogue of Fazbear Frights 5: Bunny Call.

Ella's appearance seems to be relatively similar to the illustrations of her novel trilogy counterpart. She is about two feet tall with brown curly hair, big dark eyes, and plump pink cheeks, which reminds Delilah of the baby she envisioned having one day. Ella also has thick lashes and baby-soft "skin." Her pretty baby face is partially shadowed by her blue hat, with its wide brim fringed in pink ruffles. Ella wears a puffy-sleeved, 1980s-era bright blue full-skirted dress with pink ruffled trim and a big bow around the waist. Because she is electronic, she is heavier than she looks. Ella has a small digital clock embedded in her chest, which can be activated by pressing a sequence of little buttons on her round belly.

When at the garage sale in 1:35 A.M., a bright pink tag reading “My name is Ella,” and an instructional booklet was hung around Ella’s wrist at the garage sale. Pinned to her dress is a note explaining that only the alarm clock works. There was a little white price tag stuck to the back of Ella's neck.

Ella is a high-tech electronic doll manufactured by Fazbear Entertainment. She was a "helper doll" designed to do a number of tasks, such as keeping time and serving as an alarm clock, managing appointments, keeping track of lists, taking photos, reading stories, singing songs, and serving drinks. Ella could also test the pH level in water and do personality assessments when the owner answered her programmed list of 200 questions. The doll Delilah finds, however, can only function as an alarm clock.

entities.name: Fazbear Friendly Face
entities.description:
, shorted to simply the Friendly Face, is the titular hybrid animatronic in Friendly Face, the first story of Fazbear Frights 10: Friendly Face.

Fazbear Friendly Faces are animatronic recreations of deceased pets in which the pet’s face is integrated onto an animatronic body. An example of a Friendly Face used in an advertisement is a robotic orange cat.

Edward’s Friendly Face is meant to be a robotic black cat, but after submitting the wrong black hair the cat body instead has Jack’s stiff, dead powder-white face. It has Jack’s brown eyes, slightly flat nose, thick lips turned up in an unyielding smile, and broad chin. Edward buries his Friendly Face but it escapes, covering itself in mud.

Fazbear Friendly Faces are meant to be recreations of deceased pets manufactured by Fazbear Entertainment. They are created by first extracting DNA from the pet's hairs submitted by its owner, which is then used to create an accurate recreation of the pet's face. The face is added onto a realistic animatronic body and turned into a loyal pet that will follow its owner around forever.

entities.name: Felix the Shark
entities.description:
Felix was a sleek, six feet long animatronic shark with shiny and smooth blue-gray rubbery skin, warm dark eyes, and an upturned mouth full of teeth. After years of being abandoned, however, his appearance begins to decay. Felix's skin becomes mottled, hanging in strips that flutter out behind the shark as he swims and reveals his corroded endoskeleton. One of his black eyes dangles from his face.

Felix was an animatronic that had its own area at its respective Freddy Fazbear's Pizza place, a small underwater swimming system where guest could put on a set of scuba gear and swim laps around the building with Felix once he was released by the pizza place's staff.

While searching for Felix, Dirk discovers that Felix is based on an experience the author of his favorite book had when at the beach with her family. The family suffered a great loss that day with their youngest child, Lonnie, drowning. Aaron then spotted a shark approaching the poor child's floating corpse. Both parents thought the shark would most likely eat the body, but instead, the shark pushed the body towards Aaron and then swam off after the father picked up the body.

Aaron built the pizza place with the castle-style moat attraction in honor of the shark. The business did well at first, but it went downhill after parents told the owners Felix had scared their kid(s) and they were suffering nightmares as well as one child almost drowning inside the moat, which caused the pizzeria to be closed down. After some time had passed, the town decided to build a water park above the abandoned pizza place which didn't last very long due to unknown reasons and was also eventually shut down.

entities.name: Fetch
entities.description:
is the main antagonist of the first story of the same name from Fazbear Frights 2: Fetch of the Fazbear Frights series. He appears in a secret minigame in Five Nights at Freddy's: Into the Pit.

Fetch is an animatronic dog about the size of a beagle. He has a large head shaped like a triangle, pointy on the top with a very wide mouth full of sharp, metal teeth at the bottom. Fetch has big pointed ears, a sloped forehead, a long snout with a big nose, and piercing yellow eyes. His matted grayish-brown fur is missing in places, revealing tarnished metal underneath. A couple of wires stick out of Fetch's ears, and a partially exposed hole in his belly reveals a primitive circuit board. Under his belly is a panel. Fetch wears a blue collar around his neck with a dog tag reading "Fetch."

The illustration and cover art shows Fetch as a light-brown animatronic dog, with big nose and some freckles on his snout, mouth filled with sharp teeth, and black eyes with orange irises. He wears a black collar. He is also noticeably not withered.

In Into the Pit, Fetch seems to be completely metallic. He also sports a blue "visor".

entities.name: Foxy the Pirate
entities.description:
Foxy is the main antagonist of Fazbear Frights 4: Step Closer's story of the same name, and later appears as a minor character in the epilogue of Fazbear Frights 6: Blackbird.

Based on his original counterpart, Foxy is a big, old, and broken down red fox animatronic. He has glowing yellow eyes, red eyebrows, and a jaw with sharp, pointy teeth. Foxy wears an eye patch over his right eye. One of his arms has a hook for a hand while the other hand is stripped of its fur, revealing its mechanical endoskeleton. Foxy's chest is ripped open, exposing more of his endoskeleton body.

Homicidal and barbarous, Foxy has a voice box to repeatedly sing a morbid song about becoming a pirate, over and over.

Foxy appears alongside Freddy, Bonnie, and Chica in an abandoned Freddy Fazbear's Pizza.

entities.name: Funtime Foxy
entities.description:
Funtime Foxy is a funtime animatronic who appeared once as a minor antagonist in Room for One More, the second story of Fazbear Frights 3: 1:35AM.

Funtime Foxy's appearance is similar to its appearance in Sister Location. It is described, however, to have "knifelike teeth".

Funtime Foxy briefly appears in one of Stanley's dreams as a taxi cab driver. Stanley is running late to work, but he doesn't know where he is. The street where he lives, Forrest Avenue, now says, Fazbear Avenue. Worried, he calls a cab to drive him to his job, but the cab drops him off to the wrong location, a shady side-street. He tells the cab driver that they were at the wrong address, but the driver reveals itself to be Funtime Foxy, and shatters the glass panel between the two of them, to lunge at Stanley with its jaws open.

entities.name: Lonely Freddy
entities.description:
is a brand of animatronic toys manufactured by Fazbear Entertainment. One of these serves as a main antagonist from Fazbear Frights 2: Fetch's second story of the same name. They are animatronic-like toy versions of Freddy Fazbear.

In the story, they're described as smaller versions of Freddy Fazbear. They're two feet tall with glowing deep blue eyes, soft plush paws, and unhinged, stuffed mouths. When idle, they stand in a stock-straight posture with a dead stare. The main Lonely Freddy, that is inhabited by Alec's consciousness after body-swapping with him, has light green eyes and is vomited on.

In the unused illustration they look similar to their description in the book. They also have freckles on their snouts, little speakers on their chests, and upper teeth.

The Lonely Freddies are intended to play with children at parties who have no one else to play with. The main Lonely Freddy in the story, however, has the ability to paralyze, interrogate, and eventually swap bodies with another person. It's speculated that Lonely Freddy was created and controlled by William Afton to steal children's souls like the Funtime Animatronics. It is unknown whether all Lonely Freddies were built for this purpose, or William has tampered with this single toy.

entities.name: Lucky Boy
entities.description:
is the main antagonist of Sergio's Lucky Day, the second story of Fazbear Frights 8: Gumdrop Angel. He appears as a cameo in Five Nights at Freddy's: Into the Pit.

Lucky Boy is a small, about ten-inch-high, plastic electronic figurine that is extremely similar to Balloon Boy. He has reddish brown hair, big blue eyes, an orange triangular nose, rosy cheeks, and a wide mouth full of pronounced white teeth. Lucky Boy's round head is the same shape and size as the trunk of his body. He wears a short-sleeved, two-button shirt with vertical red and blue stripes, which matches the on his cap. On top of Lucky Boy's cap is a bright red propeller. His shirt is tucked into solid blue pants, and the pants cuffs end at the top of a pair of brown shoes which are more rounded than foot-shaped. Lucky Boy's fingerless, stumpy hands holds a large red-and-yellow-striped balloon in his right hand and a small sign that reads "I'M A LUCKY BOY." in the other.

Sergio discovers Lucky Boy in a dumpster. He plays with the toy and finds out that it can respond to him. Down on his luck, he decides to take Lucky Boy with him to see if it improves his life. He purchases a lottery ticket after the toy says "It's your lucky day!" and finds out he won $600,000. Sergio asks the toy how he should spend the money, and he advises him to buy an expensive sports car and gold watch. After his car is stolen, the toy responds to his questions that he should buy a cheap house and renovate, and buy an expensive truck to replace the car. Sergio thanks Lucky Boy for his advice and does exactly what he says. He keeps him a secret.

After having a fight with his girlfriend Violet, he asks Lucky Boy what he should do. He says "You deserve to be happy", and Sergio realizes that his relationship with her has never made him happy. He breaks up with her and asks the toy what he should do about his job. He says to start his own business, and Sergio realizes that was the type of job he truly wanted. He begins to idolize Lucky Boy to thank him for the luck.

entities.name: Minireena
entities.description:
The Minireenas are the main antagonists of Room for One More, the second story in Fazbear Frights 3: 1:35AM.

The Minireenas are almost completely identical to their game counterparts from Sister Location. They're simple wooden ballerina dolls with jointed arms and legs. The Minireenas have painted white faces, big black eyes sockets that are blank and empty, no noses, and big black mouths that are toothless, grinning, gaping holes. Shining yellow irises can appear in their eyes. The Minireenas wear tiny white tutus, and their little feet are painted white to represent ballet slippers.

Stanley later realizes that some Minireenas are slightly different from each other. One had a tiny scratch on its face, another had a small tear in its tutu, and one was missing an arm. This indicates the story's Minireenas are old and slightly worn down, in some fashion.

During Stanley’s fourth dream sequence, he sees a human-sized Minireena acting as a dentist. It wore dark safety goggles and a surgical mask.

entities.name: Minor Animatronics
entities.description:
This is a list of minor animatronics and bots from the Fazbear Frights series. They have a very small role in the series.

This monkey-shaped robot is created by Ms. Billings and was designed to crash its cymbals to quiet the class, although can be only controlled with a remote. Its design description may be based on the cymbal-banging monkey toy.

A spider-shaped endoskeleton is created by Mrs. Billings. It was capable of attaching stickers to keep track of participation.

The robot is created by Mrs. Billings. It was modeled after the horse and gallops around the classroom to demonstrate an engine.

entities.name: Plushtrap Chaser
entities.description:
is a line of animatronic toy rabbits. One of them serves as the main antagonist of Out of Stock, the third story of Fazbear Frights 2: Fetch.

Plushtrap Chasers are furry dark green animatronic rabbit toys which stand at three feet tall. They have plastic eyes that bulge out of wide eye sockets, making their faces appear skeletal. Plushtrap Chasers also have pointed canine-looking teeth, whiskers, and long, crooked ears. They have jointed arms and legs and are relatively light, mainly weighed down by their heads and oversized feet. Under the fur on their backs is a line of Velcro closed over a battery compartment, which takes 9-volt batteries. There’s a little black switch on their feet. On the side of their metal jaws is a charging port.

The main Plushtrap Chaser in Out of Stock is defective. It has straight, slightly yellow human teeth, which are set in human gums. The Plushtrap Chaser also has cloudy green human eyes. The battery compartment is corroded with white crust. Below the compartment is a pattern of small holes for a speaker. As it bites into things, its human teeth sharpen and bleed, gleaming in the darkness.

The unused illustration shows the main one as yellow-green animatronic rabbit. Its eyes are plastic and bulging, its mouth is filled with pointed teeth, and its ears are jointed.

entities.name: Ralpho
entities.description:
is the main antagonist in Bunny Call, the first story in the book of the same name.

Ralpho is a tall rabbit-based character, being over six-and-a-half feet tall not including his floppy ears, which add at least an another foot. He has bright orange fur and wears a white-and-black checked vest, a yellow-and-white polka-dot bow tie, and a black top hat which his ears stick straight up out of. Ralpho holds a pair of cymbals. He has a big head said to be about the size of an exercise ball. Ralpho has bright pink eyes and furry orange paws, which bleed after being attacked by Bob Mackenzie. It’s unclear if he is a costume or an animatronic, although his bleeding suggests the former.

On the book's cover art, Ralpho appears much smaller. He wears a blue striped black hat. Ralpho has blushed, blue cheeks and buck teeth. He also has blue eyes. Unlike the usual animatronics Ralpho doesn't have a segmented body, further suggesting he may be costume rather than an animatronic.

Ralpho is used in what is known as a "Bunny Call", where he visits each cabin that has signed up for it on the first day at camp in the early morning hours between 5 and 6 AM. He bursts into each cabin while screaming, smashing his cymbals together and violently jerking his head around. This is supposed to energize children by providing an abrupt rush of terror. It isn't directly stated whether Ralpho is an animatronic or a costume, but because it lacks a segmented, jointed body it is presumably a costume.

entities.name: Rosie Porkchop
entities.description:
is the antagonist of Together Forever, the third story of Fazbear Frights 10: Friendly Face.

Rosie Porkchop is a huge, life-sized pink pig animatronic with a broad head and fuzzy skin. She wears a frilly waitress uniform in a shade of pink slightly darker than her skin and a pillbox-shaped pink cap with a ruffled edge. Besides Rosie's outfit and fuzzy hands, she looks similar to a real pig. She has a pink potbelly, stubby legs, a curly tail, and a sweet, smiling face. Rosie is also old, as Jessica can see glinting silver showing through her pink felt layer in various spots. Her fingers are only slightly padded by pink felt. Rosie’s lower belly can pop open, revealing a network of metal gears, prongs, and sharp rods lining the interior wall. Rosie’s stomach is big enough to fit two people at most.

Rosie Porkchop is a springlock suit similar to Fredbear and Spring Bonnie and most likely shares traits from the two, being able to switch from springlock to costume at will. Rosie is shown to be programable from a laptop in both suit and animatronic form and will follow set programming once uploaded. Rosie is also shown to have immense strength, as if someone is grabbed by her, they will not be able to break free until told to by the programming.

entities.name: RWQFSFASXC
entities.description:
RWQFSFASXC, also known as Shadow Bonnie or RXQ for short, is the main antagonist of Hide-and-Seek, the third story of Fazbear Frights 6: Blackbird.

Like his game counterpart, Shadow Bonnie is pitch black. However, unlike his game counterpart, he doesn't closely resemble Toy Bonnie. Instead, Shadow Bonnie starts out as a black two-dimensional cutout of Bonnie the Rabbit for the Hide-and-Seek game. When Toby destroys the game, it attaches itself to Toby’s back. In this form, Shadow Bonnie appears as a dark shadow with rabbit ears. Eventually, it grows in size and two narrow eyes form on the shadow. Shadow Bonnie later forms a row of two spiked teeth.

Shadow Bonnie stars in the minigame Hide-and-Seek. at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza and Games. Upon the game starting, Shadow Bonnie slides out on a rail and hides in one of fifteen locations. The player must find Shadow Bonnie in three tries within three minutes in order to win. He is released when the protagonist Toby destroys the game out of anger.

Shadow Bonnie fills two distinct roles: the sought after character in Hide-and-Seek and Toby's tormentor. When Hide-and-Seek opens at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza and Games, Toby sees it as the perfect opportunity to finally beat his brother Connor at one of the location's games. Unable to win on the first day, Toby makes rail blocks in woodworking class and on the next attempt, begins blocking off parts of the game, limiting the locations the rabbit can use to hide. Despite this, Shadow Bonnie remains evasive. Angered, Toby blocks off every section so the rabbit can't hide anywhere. When the game lights next turn off, Shadow Bonnie wasn't blocked and disappeared. After checking every location and finding nothing, Toby snaps and destroys the game.

entities.name: Sideshow
entities.description:
Sideshow is a plain brown bear. The animatronic Mandy Mason finds has flat brown fur that sags on the frame of the body. Its ears droop, one eye is closed while the other is open, and its mouth is sewn shut.

Little can be gathered about Sideshow's functionality from his appearance in his story, as he appears deactivated when he's found by Mandy.

Sideshow appears as the mascot of Sideshow's Snack Shack for three years before being shut down after a boy named Stevie Robins goes missing. 17 years later, a girl named Mandy is guided to the old building and finds Sideshow in a deactivated state. After removing the animatronic's head, she finds Stevie's decayed corpse inside, presumably having hid there without being able to get out.
