entities.name: Renelle Talbert
entities.description:
Renelle is a small preteen with curly black hair, dark brown eyes, and pink-tinged skin.

When Renelle was little, she was constantly sick. She went in and out of the hospital a lot, and Dr. Talbert was scared for her life. She studies the substance of Remnant, creating a heart shaped pendant as a gift for her. Eventually, she conquered her illness and could live a normal life.

According to Eleanor, two years prior to the events of the epilogues, Renelle's mom passed away. Both she and her father were in grief, but became distant to one another. Dr. Talbert sent Renelle away to boarding school, while sinking deeper into his work of studying the strange substance of Remnant. When Renelle returned, she stole some of his money out of spite. Dr. Talbert, acting out of rage, kicked Renelle out of the house. It's unclear what happened to Renelle afterwards.

Dr. Talbert's studying of Remannt got the attention of Eleanor, an evil animatronic who enjoyed the suffering of others. She wanted Remnant for herself to become more powerful, and decides to exploit Dr. Talbert by pretending to be his lost daughter. Eleanor finds out about the family's falling out, and uses it to her advantage.
entities.short_description: Renelle is a small preteen with curly black hair, dark brown eyes, and pink-tinged skin.

entities.name: Robert Stanton
entities.description:
is the protagonist of The Cliffs, the first story in the book of the same name. He is a single father who's still mourning the loss of his wife and doesn't think he's enough for his son, Tyler. Robert buys a fancy teddy bear to watch over Tyler, but when Tyler disappears the bear begins pushing Robert to his limit.

Robert is not described in the story. In it's graphic novel adaptation, Robert is tall and skinny with spiky blond hair, blue eyes, an angular face, an aquiline nose, and stubble. In certain shots, his arms appear rather hairy.

Robert used to be happy and energetic. When Anna died, however, he became incredibly grief-stricken. Robert isolates himself from others in order to not feel their pity and care for Tyler. As a result he's painfully lonely, yet finds himself too busy and exhausted to change this. Robert also believes he's useless and inept as a father, relying on parenting books to get by. He becomes overwhelmed easily by memories of Anna, and Tyler’s similar appearance to her overwhelms Robert with love and fear. Robert is unwilling to discuss Anna, instead choking back his sadness to control his reactions. He also doesn’t care much for eating, only doing so when Tyler needs to. Robert isn’t really superstitious, yet is still scared and wary of supernatural stories told about the Cliffs. After Tyler’s disappearance, Robert becomes suicidal, while also being aggressive towards Tag-Along Freddy until all his feelings go numb. Robert later learns to love what he has and live his life better.

Robert is the father of his son, Tyler. His wife, Anna, died during childbirth. As a result, he dedicates most of his life to taking care of Tyler, knowing that he would never be enough for him. One day at the store, he purchases Tag-Along Freddy to keep watch over his son. He realizes that his life is easier knowing that something was keeping track of Tyler.

Dr. Ron Tabor, aka Dr. T, is a major character from Sea Bonnies, the second story from Fazbear Frights 10: Friendly Face.

Ron has big ears and an equally large nose, as well as a goatee that comes to a point under his chin. He’s also short and completely bald, having shaved what remained of his light brown hair three years ago. Mott says Ron is kind of funny-looking and compares him to the seven dwarves, or a gnome.

Ron is one of the nicest people Mott knows, more so than his mother, as he never loses his temper, unlike his mother on some occasions.

Rory is a major character in Sea Bonnies, the second story of Fazbear Frights 10: Friendly Face.

Rory has his mother’s bright red hair. With tufts of hair that refuses to lay down properly on his head, overly large eyes and mouth, and a freckled face, Mott says Rory looks rather goofy. He's also skinny with bony arms.

entities.name: Sam O'Neil
entities.description:
is the deuteragonist of Blackbird, the first story in Fazbear Frights 6: Blackbird. He's a rather tall and awkward young man who goes missing after nearly getting hit by a train.

Sam is six-foot-five with 37 inch long legs and huge feet, making him look like a stock, heron, or crane. He's dark and skinny with strong features, a wide mouth, and a sharp jawline, which makes him look harsh, angry, and serious even when he isn't. Sam also has an almost military haircut and wears a ton of black, red, and tan. His shirts are crisply ironed thanks to his mother.

Sam is a smart and funny person who is usually honest and open. He's also somewhat nerdy, finding it more fun to work on projects than drink and party. Sam is rather introverted too, preferring quiet over the campus’s constant chatter, angst, and fast pace. This can make him seem uncool, but he still makes friends easily due to his nice attitude. Sam is rather insecure about himself due to his height, which makes him clumsy. He doesn’t feel like he fits in with mainstream life and used to be a target for bullies until he struck back. While Sam later regrets what he did, he still has a strong dislike of bullies.

Sam is close friends with Nole, seeing him as cooler than the nerd he was. He and Nole come up with the Blackbird monster together for their cinematography class. The Blackbird is stated to punish a person after they reveal their darkest secret, and must either atone for it or suffer the consequences. When the costume is completed, Sam puts it on as Nole confesses his darkest secret of making a young girl's life miserable through bullying. Sam, who was currently being picked on for his legs, dislikes how his best friend burdened another person with that same suffering.
entities.short_description: is the deuteragonist of Blackbird, the first story in Fazbear Frights 6: Blackbird. He's a rather tall and awkward young man who goes missing after nearly getting hit by a train.

entities.name: Samantha
entities.description:
is one of the protagonists of Coming Home, the third story in Fazbear Frights 4: Step Closer. She's a rather serious young girl who keeps to herself, haunted by guilt and sorrow following her older sister's death. When Susie begins literally haunting Samantha, she opens up about the events leading to her death and tries making things right.

Samantha has light-brown hair caught tight in a ponytail and brown eyes that are often squinting, which makes her look cautious. She has her dad’s large round nose and mouth, and her grandma said she’ll grow to be a handsome woman when she's older. Samantha has lean cheeks and, unlike Susie, her ears aren't pierced. She has a bump on her nose and a little check mark-shaped scar under her right eye. Samantha and Susie are the same height despite Susie being a year older.

Samantha wears neatly tied navy blue sneakers. When she’s attacked by Chica, she wears a thick, soft pale-blue flannel nightgown and stockings.

Samantha is very serious and hard to read. She has an opinion about everything and wants to be independent, doing things her own way and bossing others around. Despite her assertive attitude, Samantha isn’t mean and likes when others are happy. She doesn’t like frivolous things like Susie, finding them stupid. Samantha also doesn’t like sharing other things, wanting what’s hers to be hers. She is very organized and likes things to be in their right place, hating messes and change. Samantha likes learning and figuring things out, blowing bubbles as a way to study air currents. She has a vivid imagination, scaring herself with just a thought or two whenever something strange happens. After Susie’s death, Samantha stops talking as often as she used to. She also only tolerates the slightest touch, but makes an exception for Susie.
entities.short_description: is one of the protagonists of Coming Home, the third story in Fazbear Frights 4: Step Closer. She's a rather serious young girl who keeps to herself, haunted by guilt and sorrow following her older sister's death. When…

entities.name: Sarah
entities.description:
Sarah is the protagonist of To Be Beautiful, the second story from Fazbear Frights #1: Into the Pit. She's a heavily self-conscious teenage girl who wants to be what she believes is beautiful, and one day comes across someone who seemingly makes this wish a reality.

Sarah describes herself as fat and flat, comparing her shape to a potato. She has dull, mousy brown hair that becomes frizzy and gets cut a few inches shorter after she fails to properly dye it. Sarah also has a bulbous nose, prominent ears, stubby limbs, blue eyes, and Caucasian skin that's usually sallow and dry. Her elbows are usually chapped and her nails are short and nubby. Sarah applies some mascara and pink-tinted lip balm to her face. She usually wears jeans to school to draw less attention to her short legs.

After getting the necklace and silver heart pendant from Eleanor, Sarah wakes up everyday and discovers a new part of her body has changed. First, her arms become slimmer, more toned, and soft and smooth. Sarah's fingers become long, elegant, and tapered, and her nails are longer than her fingertips and shaped in perfect ovals. They're also painted a gorgeous, soft pink. The next day, Sarah's legs become long and shapely, with toned calves and dainty ankles. They're also smooth and sleek, and her toenails are the same rosy pink as her fingernails. The next day, Sarah's body becomes slender and curvy. Finally, her nose becomes tiny and straight, her cheekbones become defined, and her lips become a plump pink Cupid's bow. Sarah's eyes become wide and a deeper blue with long, sooty lashes. Her eyebrows become delicate arches and her hair becomes fuller and shinier, falling into soft waves. Sarah also gets straight, white teeth. She begins to wear more elegant and trendy clothes as well.

When the necklace falls off, Sarah's body slowly reveals itself to be nothing but scraps from a junkyard, which eventually falls off and turns into a pile of junk.

entities.name: Sarah's Family
entities.description:
Sarah's Family in Fazbear Frights comprises the relatives of Sarah from To Be Beautiful, the second story of Fazbear Frights 1: Into the Pit.

Sarah is the main protagonist of the first Fazbear Frights book's second story.

Sarah's unnamed mother is a social worker and very supportive to her daughter. She doesn't understand Sarah's preoccupation with beauty, but she still hangs out with her daughter and takes her to the mall.

Sarah's unnamed older brother is away at college majoring in computer science. When Eleanor first turns on and begins speaking to Sarah, she ponders if he would know how she works.
entities.short_description: Sarah's Family in Fazbear Frights comprises the relatives of Sarah from To Be Beautiful, the second story of Fazbear Frights 1: Into the Pit.

entities.name: Sarah's Mother
entities.description:
Sarah's unnamed mother is a major character in To Be Beautiful, the second story from Fazbear Frights 1: Into the Pit. She is a social worker who is somewhat clueless to Sarah's obsessions and feelings.

Sarah’s mother is naturally pretty with salt-and-pepper hair worn long and loose. She does not wear makeup, she doesn’t stylize her hair, and she has a tendency to put on weight around her hips. At the start of the story, she's dressed for work in a long floral print dress.

While Sarah's mom cares and loves Sarah, she can be rather clueless to her daughter's low self esteem and obsession with beauty. Still, she tries to be supportive and buys Sarah clothes and other products to help with her appearance. Sarah's mom also enjoys thrifting.

Sarah's mother raised Sarah mostly by herself, as Sarah's father was rarely around and left when she was young. Sarah, her mother, and her brother lived in a two-bedroom bungalow until her brother moved away for college. When Sarah was eleven, she and her mom visited New York. There, they saw a Broadway show, ridden a ferry to the Statue of Liberty, and gone up in the Empire State Building. Instead of shopping in fancy stores, they visit and souvenir shop, where Sarah bought a "I LOVE NEW YORK" T-shirt. For Sarah's fourteenth birthday, her mom gives her permission to wear a little light makeup. She also buys her a lovely lavender dress the previous spring.
entities.short_description: Sarah's unnamed mother is a major character in To Be Beautiful, the second story from Fazbear Frights 1: Into the Pit. She is a social worker who is somewhat clueless to Sarah's obsessions and feelings.

entities.name: Sergio Altieri
entities.description:
is the titular protagonist of Sergio's Lucky Day, the second story of Fazbear Frights 8: Gumdrop Angel. He is a highly insecure man who wants nothing more than to be impressive, but never feels satisfied whenever he climbs the ladder at work. After a terrible string of bad luck, Sergio comes across a unique toy and his luck begins to change.

Sergio is five foot seven with a long and somewhat pointed nose, big ears, small and beady eyes, and thick lips. He used to be compact, slender, muscular and sleek, but once he became project manager he gains a growing potbelly. Sergio wears his black hair slicked back, and always dresses in dark, fitted clothing. He doesn’t consider himself good-looking, but he tries to have his own impressive style.

Sergio is an architectural phenom that excels at math and has an eye for spatial relationships, knowing how to mold something eye-catching. This talent helps him reach his biggest dream, which is to be impressive. Sergio is highly determined to reach his ideals and works hard to get what he wants, although he lacks foresight and never feels satisfied upon reaching his next step. He also wants freedom to do whatever he wants and becomes frustrated by the safe, limited changes he’s tasked with. Sergio can’t read people and is unsure of what others around him feel or think. He also finds being friendly difficult and prefers staying at home with takeout rather than attending social events, even if he enjoys showing off his dance moves. Sergio is very selfish and craves validation, wanting a girlfriend who dotes on him and shares his interests, like sci-fi. He even lies his way through his first steady relationship purely because a steady girlfriend made him feel impressive.

After finding Lucky Boy, Sergio becomes very delusional and senses negative undertones in others when none are present. He also becomes highly possessive and dependent on Lucky Boy.

entities.name: Shelly Girard
entities.description:
Shelly Girard is a major character from The Breaking Wheel, the second story in Fazbear Frights 7: The Cliffs. She is a nerdy teenage girl and one of Reed's only friends, although Reed hopes to become more than just friends one day.

Shelly has thick black hair that she wears in a particular chin-length style which puts the ends right at mouth level. She also has long bangs covering her forehead. Like her twin brother, Pickle, Shelly is short and dark, and both Reed and Julius find her rather pretty. She has large eyes, long lashes, and a full mouth. Shelly also has small square hands with bitten-to-the-nub fingernails. She always wears baggy button-down shirts with her jeans. Shelly also likes to wear beaded bracelets.

Shelly is a science and information geek that loves sharing whatever she learns, constantly reading everywhere and speaking aloud when she does. She also enjoys schoolwork, always excited to answer questions in class and finding long homework sessions fun. Shelly is obsessed with order and is a perfectionist, never doing anything halfway and abandoning projects if she can’t do it well. She admires Reed since he’s unpredictable, giving her a challenge and keeping her interested. Shelly also likes teasing him. She has a few little imperfections that make her charming to some, such as chewing on her hair while concentrating. However, Shelly can come off as arrogant and thoughtless because she gets wrapped up in her books and projects.

Reed had been friends with Shelly and Pickle for nearly ten years around the time the story takes place. When they were five, Reed showed a lack of engineering skills when he tried to build a log cabin, something Shelly likes to remind him of. Eventually, Reed begins to wonder if he and Shelly can ever be more than friends. One day, he spots a cloud in the sky that looked exactly like a castle, and he joked with Shelly that it means impossible dreams can happen. Shelly responds by saying Reed's right and squinting at him. For her birthday, Reed bought Shelly a word-of-the-day calendar, which she uses to learn more words. At some point, Shelly tells Reed that Julius's hair is dreamy, although his personality isn't. In their freshman year, Shelly and Pickle convince Reed to join a robotics class, as Shelly believed it would be fun to take the class together.

entities.name: Sophia Manchester
entities.description:
Sophia Manchester is a major yet unseen character from Sergio's Lucky Day, the second story in Fazbear Frights 8: Gumdrop Angel. She was a kind and popular girl in Sergio's high school that Sergio continues to long for ten years later.

Sophia is small with dark features and a beautiful face.

Sophia is said to be graceful like a ballerina. She is also very smart, nice, and funny. Sophia was always perfectly kind to Sergio and shared similar interests with him, but her popularity led to them spending very little time together.

entities.name: Stanley
entities.description:
Stanley is the protagonist of Fazbear Frights 3: 1:35AM's second story, Room for One More. He is a lonely man who comes across a strange ballerina doll while working as a security guard in a secretive underground facility.

Stanley is short and overweight, and he's inherited his father's receding hairline. He normally wears his security uniform and his shiny badge.

When the Minireenas start entering Stanley, he gets sickly gray skin, bloodshot eyes with dark shadows under them, a bleeding throat, and numb, swollen limbs. He also ends up with a stubble on his jaw and chin as he does not trust himself with his swollen limbs to shave. It gets to a point where Stanley has to wear a plain white T-shirt to work as his uniform is torn up.

Stanley is very sad and lonely due to his girlfriend, Amber, breaking up with him. His big appetite and love of eating has turned into emotional eating after the break up, and he loses his motivation and starts caring less. Stanley can be rather stubborn and uses the passing of his father to justify his fear of doctors. He is also easily amused, especially by childish things, and in his loneliness begins speaking to inanimate objects. Stanley often broods over his current life, which makes him vulnerable. He doesn’t usually cry and hides his moments of weakness from others out of embarrassment.

entities.description:
Stanley's Family in Fazbear Frights comprises the relatives of Stanley from Room for One More, the second story of Fazbear Frights 3: 1:35AM.

Stanley is the main protagonist of the third Fazbear Frights book's second story.

Main article: MelissaMelissa is Stanley's older sister. When Stanley's reports feeling sick, she comes over to his apartment to help him. She helps Stanley eat food and cleans his apartment.

Stanley's unnamed granny is mentioned a few times due to her strange sayings. When reflecting on his job interview Stanley comments that companies wanted to make sure they "weren't hiring the fox to guard the henhouse," which his granny used to say. Later, when Melissa is cleaning up Stanley's apartment she says he "look like a Death holding a cracker," a saying from their Granny that their never understood.

entities.description:
Stanton's Family in Fazbear Frights comprises the relatives of Robert Stanton from The Cliffs, the first story of Fazbear Frights 7: The Cliffs.

Robert Stanton is the main protagonist of the seventh Fazbear Frights book's first story.

After losing Tyler, Robert considers suicide because he has lost everyone who mattered to him. As he is contemplating his decision, he realizes that Anna would have wanted him to live for as long as possible, even without her. He angrily chucks Tag-Along Freddy off the Cliffs to look for Tyler. When he finds him, he begins to tell him stories about Anna.

Joel D'Agostino (Son)|first_appearance=Kids at Play}} Steve D'Agostino is a major character in Kids at Play, the second story in Fazbear Frights 11: Prankster.

Steve has a dark face with brown eyes and strong features. He is big, broad-shouldered, and fit with precisely trimmed graying black hair and farmer's-tanned skin on the back of his neck. When he isn't working at the nursery, Steve wears flashy clothes like dressy slacks, bright shirts, and patterned ties.

entities.name: Back Alley
entities.description:
The is a secondary location in Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator. It is where Scrap Baby, Scraptrap, Molten Freddy, or Lefty reside in. This location is also where the player can throw the salvageable animatronics back by choice.

{|class="article-table" align="center" border="1" cellpadding="1" cellspacing="1" style="text-align:center;"

The Back Alley is a gray-bricked alleyway with multiple garbage bags and trash cans. There are also document papers and posters ("The Legend of the Terrible Man-Wolf", "One Night at the Opera", "Spook Fest", and few unknown advertisement/show posters depicting a grinning clown) printing on walls.

In very rare occasions, there is a possibility that when starting, ending, or dying in a game the player will see a screen of either Scrap Baby, Scraptrap, Molten Freddy, or Lefty in the alley during a thunderstorm.

entities.name: Stevie Robins
entities.description:
Stevie Robins is the main antagonist of The Scoop, the second story in Fazbear Frights 12: Felix the Shark.

Stevie is a small boy with somewhat spiky and mussed brown hair, brown eyes, jeans, blue sneakers, and a bright red shirt with Sideshow on it. As a ghost, he has huge and sharp teeth. As Mandy continues to see Stevie his skin gets paler, his cheeks sink in, dark circles rim his dark eyes, and his hair gets limp and greasy. Eventually dark veins line his face and his hair thins out, exposing parts of his skull.

entities.name: Backstage
entities.description:
The is a location in Five Nights at Freddy's within Freddy Fazbear's Pizza. It contains spare parts for the animatronics, should they happen to break during the day.

The Backstage is a small room located to the left of the Show Stage, used to store spare animatronic parts. The room consists of a checkered, white-and-black tiled floor and a small table, on which sits an endoskeleton (Endo-01) and an extra Bonnie head.

To the back and left of the room sits a shelf, holding three spare Bonnie heads, two of Chica's, and three of Freddy Fazbear's. An open door can be seen on the right wall, with a sign that says "EMPLOYEES ONLY" above it. Wires hang loosely from the ceiling to the right of the camera.

entities.name: Susie
entities.description:
Susie is one of the protagonists of Coming Home, the third story in Fazbear Frights 4: Step Closer. She is an empathic young girl with a vivid imagination. A year after her death at the hands of a serial killer, her ghost returns and unknowingly haunts her mother, Patricia, and younger sister, Samantha.

Susie had light-brown hair that flowed around her face and brown eyes that were usually wide open, making her look eager. She also often looked wild and mischievous. Susie was usually called cute because of her small nose and mouth. Her ears were pierced and she liked to wear pretty-colored earrings. Susie had a scar at the top of her forehead hidden under her hair. Susie and Samantha are the same height despite Susie being a year older.

Susie was wearing a magenta-and-pink striped sweater and jeans embedded with rhinestones when she was murdered.Fazbear Frights #4: Step Closer | Coming Home | "She looked the same way she’d looked the day she was abducted. She even wore the same clothes—her magenta-and-pink striped sweater and the jeans Jeanie had studded with

rhinestones." She wears the same clothes when she meets with Samantha.

entities.name: Basement 1
entities.description:
Basement 1 or B1, also called Night Light Maze, is a location in Murray's Costume Manor accessible only through the Retail Showroom. It's where Sleepy Moon is encountered.

To access this Basement, Arnold must have the executive-level data diver first to enter the Retail Showroom and use a code to enter the elevator.

Basement 1 is a dark place powered by Starbrights, with the only source of light being the hole in the middle of the room made by the giant moon prop that fell from the Story Time Showroom. The place looks like a maze with many different paths, ceiling chains, and various traps which Arnold can use to produce noise to affect Sleepy Moon.

entities.name: Susie's Family
entities.description:
Susie's Family in Fazbear Frights comprises the relatives of Susie from Coming Home, the third story of Fazbear Frights 4: Step Closer.

Susie is one of the two main protagonists of the fourth Fazbear Frights book's third story. She is described much differently then her TFC and game counterparts. She had brown hair and brown eyes and, on the day of her death, she wore a magenta sweater along with jeans with rhinestones. She was seven at the time of her passing, and was a year older than her sister, Samantha.

Samantha is one of the two main protagonists of the fourth Fazbear Frights book's third story. Samantha is Susie's polar opposite. Whereas Susie was bright, fun and energetic, Samantha is more put together and down to Earth. Samantha is very particular person, and has a specific way to do everything, including playing with toys. Samantha is very smart, and enjoys educational activities which landed her the nickname "bookworm" by the other children.

After Susie's death, her mother put her in counseling alongside herself, and can be seen using the techniques she learned throughout the story.

entities.description:
Basement 2 or B2 is a location in Murray's Costume Manor, accessible only after entering the vent in Edwin's office on the upper level of the Admin Wing. It's where the White Tiger resides.

Basement 2 is a vast empty and dark basement. Lights sometime activate in different places but then turn off again, and the only way to see in the dark is by using Starbrights. There's a secret room accessible through a vent containing "Frequency" audio log, Mimic's blueprint/sketches, Prototype Endo-01s as well as various Protomimics parts.

entities.name: Sylvia Collins
entities.description:
is the protagonist in You're the Band, the third story in Fazbear Frights 12: Felix the Shark.

Sylvia appears to be a thin woman, as her mother always thought she tended to be a little underweight.

Sylvia is a hardworking mother who tries her best to support Timmy. She deeply cares and worries about Timmy to the point where she feels parental guilt, thinking it's her fault that her son's having problems, as she took him to see a psychologist. At one point, Sylvia almost breaks down in tears as she couldn't help her son. She also goes out of her way to make Timmy's birthday party Freddy's-themed. Showcasing that she can be creative with Artistic things.

Sylvia lived in the countryside with her parents and attended elementary school there. When she was a kid, a tragic incident occurred at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, making it close its doors. Sylvia worked at the feed store when she was in high school and community college, and soon after she graduated, she moved out to the city for her new job in a law office and met James Collins, Timmy's father. James died in a fatal incident on the construction site one month before Timmy was born, making Sylvia raise her son all by herself.

entities.name: Bed
entities.description:
The is a location and a part of the Bedroom in Five Nights at Freddy's 4. It is the place where Nightmare Freddy can attack the player if they don't chase away the three Freddles. It's also where Nightmare Fredbear and Nightmare can appear. Nightmarionne appears here in the Halloween edition replacing Nightmare.

The room itself boasts the same light blue wallpaper design as the rest of the location. Directly above the bed, two pictures can be seen. To the right of the bed, a green and blue lamp can be seen, barely visible on a nightstand. The floor cannot be seen, but it is assumed that it has the same cerulean carpet as the rest of the location.

The bed itself appears to be a twin-sized bed. The blankets contain triangles of various colored patterns. There also appear to be two pillows, although they only appear under the covers. The headboard is composed of several wooden pillars, and a Freddy Fazbear plush can be seen sitting in the middle of the Bed.

Tabitha Bing is a major character in Hide-and-Seek, the third story from Fazbear Frights 6: Blackbird. She's a school outcast who takes notice of Toby’s poor health and attempts to help him.

Tabitha has black hair and a freckled face. She usually wears makeup and has a nose piercing. Tabitha also wears a lot of black.

Tabitha is somewhat of an outcast that likes to rebel against the system, occasionally starting petitions to get things changed around school. She is also very friendly and supportive, doing everything to help those she thinks need it. Because of her caring nature, Toby thinks she blows little things out of proportion.

entities.name: Bedroom
entities.description:
The is the central location in Five Nights at Freddy's 4.

The Bedroom is a relatively large room. The walls of the room consist of the same blue wallpaper as the rest of the location, before splitting into a design more like that of the Closet around halfway down. Two Doors can be seen on either side of the room. The closet can be seen directly in front, with multiple shirts hanging from the hangers above.

The walls of the room are very decorated, consisting of several stars and paintings. An air vent can also be seen on the left wall. Next to the left door, a light switch can be seen. The ceiling appears to be a simple popcorn ceiling with a single light overhead. A toy caterpillar, a blue phone, and a purple robot can be seen on the floor of the room.

There are two dressers visible in the room. The first consists of seven drawers. A few shirts can also be seen hanging out of one of them. A purple fan, a lava lamp, and an alarm clock can also be seen on top of the dresser. The second dresser consists of three drawers, and a lamp can be seen sitting on top of it.
